theory.title: Repaso integrado: atención al cliente, compras y planes futuros
theory.explanation: Este punto de control repasa los contenidos de la Unidad 8 y no introduce gramática nueva. Combina peticiones y preguntas en estilo indirecto, verbo + preposición + gerundio, conjunciones dobles, in case, not only…but also, have/get causativos, segundo condicional y futuro continuo/perfecto.
theory.tip: Elige la estructura según si transmites una petición, expresas una condición, conectas ideas o comparas planes futuros.

content.passage: A customer contacted a retailer about a faulty laptop. The assistant asked her to send the receipt and asked whether the device had been repaired before. The customer insisted on speaking to the manager. The shop offered either a replacement or a refund. The customer chose a replacement and had the laptop checked by a technician. By Friday, the shop will have delivered the new device. The customer was pleased that the service was not only quick but also helpful.

items.prompt: Report a customer request about a faulty product.
items.modelAnswer: I would ask the shop to replace the faulty headphones because the sound stops in one ear. I would explain when I bought them, show the receipt and ask what options are available.

items.prompt: Describe a time you insisted on speaking to a manager.
items.modelAnswer: I once insisted on speaking to a manager because my delivery had been cancelled twice without an explanation. I stayed polite but asked for a clear answer. The manager arranged a new delivery date.

items.prompt: Offer two solutions using either…or.
items.modelAnswer: We could either send the customer a replacement product or give them a full refund. I would explain how long each option takes and let them decide which solution they prefer.

items.prompt: Explain what you keep in case you need a refund.
items.modelAnswer: I keep the receipt and the order confirmation in case I need a refund. I also save the warranty details, especially for electrical products, because they may be useful later.

items.prompt: Describe a service that was not only quick but also helpful.
items.modelAnswer: The repair service was not only quick but also helpful. The assistant explained the problem in simple language and gave me a clear price before starting the work.

items.prompt: Talk about something you have had repaired.
items.modelAnswer: I had my old camera repaired after the battery door broke. The repair shop replaced a small part and cleaned the lens. I was pleased because the camera still takes excellent photographs.

items.prompt: Report a question about a delivery.
items.modelAnswer: I asked the company whether my delivery would arrive before the weekend. They checked the tracking information and explained that the parcel was delayed at the local depot.

items.prompt: Explain what you would buy if you had a bigger budget.
items.modelAnswer: If I had a bigger budget, I would buy a more energy-efficient laptop with a longer warranty. I would compare several models and choose one that I could use for many years.

items.prompt: Describe what you will be doing at this time tomorrow.
items.modelAnswer: At this time tomorrow, I'll be meeting a friend for lunch and then visiting a bookshop. I will probably be travelling by train, so I will check the timetable before I leave.

items.prompt: Review the most useful language from this unit.
items.modelAnswer: This unit has helped me make complaints politely, discuss purchases and explain customer service. I've practised reported requests, conditional sentences and future plans. I feel more confident dealing with everyday shopping problems.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
